source_snapshot.procedure: Install USB tools in the two front USB2 ports and run SST USB stress for 12 hours under the margin condition; source says clear SEL.
source_snapshot.criteria: No SST or BMC SEL errors.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; assigns chamber, rail, two-port setup and long supervision to a lab operator.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/IMPROVED; adds distinct slot/tool mapping, concurrency, calibration, per-port evidence and restoration.

old_problem: Pending was retained for dual-port identity, SST concurrency/profile, calibrated tolerances, per-port error rules and restoration although these are project runtime bindings around a clear manual test.
disposition_reason: ED-03 permits equipment/profile/tolerance bindings, ED-09 reserves physical port/chamber/rail work for the operator, ED-14 preserves 12 hours and ED-17 requires a preserved SEL baseline. Separate per-port evidence keeps slots1 and2 from collapsing into aggregate coverage under ED-19/20.
decision_basis: Directly read Stability row4 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history3049 and next formal row5/history3050.
Both front USB2 connectors and their tool/cable identities require independent enumeration and error evidence during one proven 40C/+5% interval.
The owner must bind whether stress is simultaneous or sequenced; either way each port receives the full approved exposure/workload and remains separately attributable.
SEL clearing is replaced by baseline/delta preservation.
Next row5 identity was directly verified; no lab or DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: Front USB2 slots1-2 40C/+5% rails 12-hour margin stress
test_case.purpose: Verify both identified front USB2.0 slots sustain their approved SST I/O coverage for 12 hours at measured 40C and +5% 5V/3.3V rails without port-specific data, disconnect, kernel or BMC errors.
required_package: Slots1-2 map and separate tool/cable serials
Pinned SST dual-port profile and concurrency rule
Calibrated chamber/rail equipment, test points and tolerances
Per-port retry/data-integrity/error policy and telemetry cadence
Qualified operator, aborts and nominal restoration
test_case.test_command: Operator maps and photographs both front USB2 ports/tools, preserves baseline evidence, verifies calibration, ramps to the approved 40C/+5% rails, confirms each tool's USB2 mode/topology, runs the complete approved simultaneous or separately attributable 12-hour SST workload, and records synchronized environment plus per-port counters/logs. Restore nominal rails/ambient and recheck both ports; agent only analyzes artifacts.
test_case.expected_result: Both slots retain correct enumeration and complete their required 12-hour workload while environment remains in tolerance; each port has no disallowed data/retry/disconnect/kernel/SST event, SEL delta is clean under the approved policy, and restoration succeeds.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires two-port identity, complete per-port workload/duration, continuous environment, separate results and restoration. One tested port, an aggregate log hiding a failed connector, nominal conditions, cleared logs or a short run is not PASS.
safety_gate: Qualified operator and approved electrical/thermal limits
Abort on loss of control, electrical/thermal limit or either port error
Preserve evidence; no automatic retry; restore nominal state
expected_evidence: Per-port USB2 topology/speed and full SST result
test_case.recovery: Stop workload on either port or environment fault, preserve the common and per-port timelines, return rails/ambient to nominal under operator control, verify both ports/system, and require new authorization for any rerun.

source_conflict.reason: All reviewed sources agree on two front USB2 ports, the margin condition and 12-hour stress.
